import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # species label variants
    species_fix = {"Gentto": "Gentoo", "Adeile": "Adelie"}
    df["species"] = df["species"].replace(species_fix)
    # island case variant
    df["island"] = df["island"].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # body_mass_g is text with commas / magnitude errors
    bm = df["body_mass_g"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False).str.strip()
    bm_num = pd.to_numeric(bm, errors="coerce")
    # correct obvious magnitude errors e.g. 3650000 -> 3650
    over = bm_num > 6500
    bm_num.loc[over] = bm_num.loc[over] / 1000
    # enforce allowed range
    bm_num = bm_num.where((bm_num >= 2500) & (bm_num <= 6500))
    df["body_mass_g"] = bm_num
    # ensure numeric columns are numeric if they arrived as object
    for col in ["flipper_length_mm", "bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "year"]:
        if col in df.columns and df[col].dtype == object:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")
    return df

def answer(df):
    dfc = clean(df)
    sub = dfc.dropna(subset=["species", "body_mass_g"])
    allowed = {"Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"}
    sub = sub[sub["species"].isin(allowed)]
    means = sub.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].mean()
    return {species: float(mean) for species, mean in means.items()}
